summary: PicoCELA Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CTO/Director Toshihito Kanai effective June 30, 2026 for personal reasons, and a simultaneous restructuring of executive positions approved June 22. CEO/Rep. Director Hiroshi Furukawa becomes Chairman, CTO, and Rep. Director; CFO/Director Hideaki Horikiri becomes President, COO, and Director. Both retain principal officer roles under SOX. The moves appear orderly, not forced, with no stated disagreement; yet they represent abrupt leadership changes at the board level—Furukawa shifts from CEO to Chairman, Horikiri adds COO. Watch for potential strategic shift, especially given Furukawa's new CTO role and Horikiri's expanded operational mandate, though no catalyst or transaction accompanies the filing.
